Record Class FieldInjectionPoint

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.inject.context.FieldInjectionPoint
Record Components:
factory - the factory owning this injection point
fieldName - the field name (for inspection)
fieldType - the field's declared type (its inner type when isProvider)
qualifierType - the marker qualifier annotation type, or null
qualifier - the qualifier annotation instance, or null
annotationMetadata - annotations present on the field
isProvider - whether the declared field is a Provider of fieldType
All Implemented Interfaces:
InjectionPoint
public record FieldInjectionPoint(Factory<?> factory, String fieldName, Type fieldType, @Nullable Class<? extends Annotation> qualifierType, @Nullable Annotation qualifier, AnnotationMetadata annotationMetadata, boolean isProvider) extends Record implements InjectionPoint
A field injection point. A qualifier is either a marker annotation type (qualifierType) or a concrete annotation instance (qualifier); at most one is non-null.
